full_details: You stood at Holy Trinity because sitting was worse, and you came home on your feet. After dinner Hobbins looked in and set the morning: six at the bridge, six horses and a spare, two shillings for the pack and the saddle, and the spare under you as far as Shipston whether you liked it or not. The inkhorn, gone an hour, was inside Hamnet's machine. In the orchard you gave Edmund two cues to practise aloud, and you took the page back. Supper was ten at the table. Judith asked for a ballad with a murder in it, Susanna asked for the answer on too quick in writing, and Hamnet asked if a player's sword is sharp. Edmund asked to come. You told him to finish school, that nothing is arranged, and that admiring a play is not a living. Your father raised the cup to your lord and let a blessing pass for a jest. Your mother put the bay grease in the pack at the table and did not speak. After, on the chamomile bench, you and Anne talked of handwriting, school-shoes and Joan. Upstairs you said you live here, and you wrote sixteen shillings.
one_sentence: You stood through the sermon, gave Edmund two cues, and sat ten at a cold pie before the horses.
title: Supper before the road
